case_name: Smt. Manjula. M @ Lavanya vs Yogeesh. J @ Vedamurthy S/O Jayanna

parties.respondent_defendant: Yogeesh. J @ Vedamurthy S/o Jayanna, husband; Jayanna. B.M., father-in-law (ex-parte)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent got married in 2015. Petitioner claims domestic violence and seeks various reliefs under Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

legal_principles.principle: A person who is innocent and has taken utmost care of the other party can seek protection under the Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005.
legal_principles.held: The respondent being husband of the petitioner and being responsible to take care of his wife and children, he is always depends on the money of the petitioner and her parents.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: A person who has been deserted by their spouse without valid reason can seek restitution of conjugal rights.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner has deserted the respondent with out having any valid reason.
